frames.fullPrompt: EDIT ONE SINGLE COMPLETE existing low-poly sculpted polarbear walking cel on transparent RGBA, not a sprite atlas. Image 1 is the current finished animal painting. Preserve its full camera canvas, head/eyes/ears/body/torso markings, palette, lighting, silhouette and body position/scale exactly. Image 2 is only a PRIVATE limb pose sketch: use it only to understand which front leg is lifting; DO NOT copy its square cut seams, rectangular paws or its pixels. Fully PAINT continuous connected real anatomy in the finished original art. Lift ONLY the NEAR FORELEG: the large outer front leg coming from the broad visible shoulder, its larger front paw is currently the RIGHT of the two front paws. Flex wrist naturally and swing its rounded black-clawed paw forward, with CLEAR 6-8% full-canvas-height AIR GAP above the supporting ground. Keep the thinner shaded FAR FORELEG to its left planted. BOTH hind legs stay planted. This is ONE-FOOT-SWING of a FOUR-BEAT WALK, NOT trot: exactly one front foot airborne and the other THREE limbs bear weight on the same ground level. Preserve all three supporting limbs. Do not raise either hind leg or the other front leg. The hoof/paw must be conspicuously airborne, not merely shifted along the floor. Keep connected joints, compact natural hoof/black-clawed paw, no rectangular projections, detached limb, extra or missing foot. Friendly adult matching existing low-poly art, not photoreal or flat cartoon. No text, guides, floor, shadow, duplicate animal or background. Keep same full image 1 canvas ratio and fixed torso camera, do not center/reframe the animal.
